protocol.pass_rule: Visible smoke, every original hidden check for the contract, and import/evaluation restrictions must all pass. One whole attempt is one vote.
protocol.gpt_oss_budget_note: Medium and low use 65536 context / 32768 output; high uses 16384 / 8192. This is not an equal-compute ranking.
protocol.supplemental_async_note: The CSV and records use the original 15 async checks. Two additional exact-int-subclass checks are reported separately in the narrative; GPT-OSS medium falls from 7 to 5 full passes, low remains 3.
protocol.grader_revision_note: The audited async worker permits all legal worker start orders. A partial score changed; full-attempt totals did not.
